verdict.rationale: Moss has no built-in natural-language interface. Its official MCP server lets a user's AI assistant create indexes, add documents and run semantic queries through conversation. The Vercel AI SDK integration also exposes Moss operations as tools that language models can call. So natural-language operation is possible, but only through a third-party assistant or agent framework. missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface, evidence that management operations such as keys and web sources can be driven conversationally, detailed MCP tool documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
